planets.name: TOI-7009 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-7009 with a 2.32-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-7009 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-7009. Its orbit and size follow Morello et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
